definitions.unit: One performance trial; scheduled intervention at evaluation second 60.
definitions.pre_action_means: 15 valid, contiguous observations at nominal seconds 30,32,...,58; equal weight. Missing or discontinuous grids remain unavailable.
definitions.growth: Last pre-action trailing 30-second growth, (Q58-Q28)/(t58-t28), using 16 valid contiguous snapshots. B growth is also retained. This differs from a mean of the historical 10-second plotted growth series.
definitions.persistence: At second 58: hot now and hot in at least 80% of the last 15 observations; lag > 10 and lag > partition mean + one population standard deviation.
definitions.resources: CPU in process cores; RSS in MiB. Requires fresh per-incarnation observations for all original consumers at all 15 sample points. No imputation.
definitions.full_evaluation_means: Equal-weight means of valid raw evaluation observations, reused from the reviewed summaries; not a time-weighted mean or a mean of rolling means.
definitions.recovery: Total processing backlog <= 100 offsets for 30 continuous valid seconds during input. Gaps/ownership changes restart the hold. Keep 3 uses second 60 as reference. Unconfirmed is censored, not zero or necessarily persistent failure.
definitions.outcomes: Completion before commit acknowledgment; cohort p99 and unfinished followed through fixed drain. Completion-window statistics use different populations and exclude drain.
definitions.useful_throughput: Distinct messages completed during the 600-second evaluation divided by 600 seconds; includes warm-up messages finishing in that interval. It is not completed evaluation-cohort messages divided by the observation period.
definitions.cost: Requested consumer resources integrated over evaluation plus drain, retained only with full request-history coverage. Not actual usage or whole-cluster cost.
definitions.interpretation: Descriptive associations; no fitted predictive model, causal feature attribution, pooled rate comparison or application-sufficiency label.
